name: Gandia (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the uncrowned arms of Gandia (a castle above waves beneath a star on blue).
history: The official flag of Gandia is of proportions 2:3, purple, with the municipal arms without a crown at the centre; it was approved by resolution of 1 June 2010 of the Conseller of Solidarity and Citizenship and published in the DOCV of 11 June 2010. The arms on the flag bear no crown, since Gandia was recognised as a town before becoming a duchy; the arms, used traditionally by the council, were approved by resolution of 12 June 1997.
